literal_meaning: মেঘ না চাইতেই জল (clouds without wanting, water)
figurative_meaning_en: Unexpected opportunity; excessive gain beyond expectation
example_sentences_in_bangla: ব্যবসায়ে তার মেঘ না চাইতেই জল পড়ল, হঠাৎ একটা বড় অর্ডার এল।
পরীক্ষায় প্রস্তুতি না নিয়েও মেঘ না চাইতেই জল পেয়ে গেল সে।
example_sentences_in_english: In his business, he got water without asking for clouds when a big order came unexpectedly.
She received an unexpected opportunity in the exam, like getting water without even asking for clouds.
history: This idiom draws from the natural imagery of monsoon rains in Bengal, symbolizing unbidden blessings from the sky, common in rural folklore.
note: The idiom reflects the agrarian context of Bengal where rain is vital and often arrives unpredictably.
